```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
with open('quicksort_page.html','r',encoding='utf-8') as f:

soup = BeautifulSoup(html,'html.parser')
pre_blocks = soup.find_all('pre')
cpp = None
for block in pre_blocks:
    if block.find_previous('h2') and 'C++' in block.find_previous('h2').text:
        cpp = block.text; break
    if '#include' in block.text and 'std::' in block.text:
        cpp = block.text; break
print(cpp if cpp else 'C++ code not found')
```
